instruction: The precondition FreeCAD file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open the given shape in FreeCAD, create a TechDraw page that includes Front, FrontBottomLeft, and Top views, add a detail view from the Top view to show useful details, include any other useful drawing details, and save the completed document to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
